examples.pinyin: Háizi de sīwéi hěn huóyuè.
examples.en: The child's thinking is very active.

examples.en: Studying math trains logical thinking.

examples.zh: 很多商店在节日前大肆打折。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō shāngdiàn zài jiérì qián dàsì dǎzhé.
examples.en: Many shops slash their prices heavily before the holidays.

examples.zh: 广告里大肆宣传这个新产品。
examples.pinyin: Guǎnggào lǐ dàsì xuānchuán zhège xīn chǎnpǐn.
examples.en: The adverts hype this new product on a massive scale.

examples.zh: 不要大肆谈论别人的事情。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào dàsì tánlùn biéren de shìqing.
examples.en: Don't go around gossiping widely about other people's business.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì yīnggāi zěnme chǔzhì?
examples.en: How should this matter be handled?

examples.zh: 经理很快就处置好了这个问题。
examples.pinyin: Jīnglǐ hěn kuài jiù chǔzhì hǎo le zhège wèntí.
examples.en: The manager quickly sorted out this problem.

examples.zh: 旧家具怎么处置，你有什么想法？
examples.pinyin: Jiù jiājù zěnme chǔzhì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ?
examples.en: What do you think we should do with the old furniture?

examples.zh: 电影里的歹徒最后还是被抓住了。
examples.pinyin: Diànyǐng lǐ de dǎitú zuìhòu háishi bèi zhuāzhùle.
examples.en: The bad guy in the film was caught in the end.

examples.zh: 警察提醒大家要小心歹徒。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá tíxǐng dàjiā yào xiǎoxīn dǎitú.
examples.en: The police remind everyone to be careful of criminals.

examples.zh: 这个小区安装了监控，防止歹徒进入。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎoqū ānzhuāngle jiānkòng, fángzhǐ dǎitú jìnrù.
examples.en: This neighbourhood installed cameras to keep criminals out.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng dézuì rènhé rén.
examples.en: I don't want to offend anyone.

examples.zh: 他这样说话，很容易得罪人。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèyàng shuōhuà, hěn róngyì dézuì rén.
examples.en: Talking like that easily offends people.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ wúyì dézuì nǐ.
examples.en: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

examples.pinyin: Tā chuānshàng xīnzhuāng, qù jiàn péngyou.
examples.en: He put on new clothes and went to see friends.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shēn zhuāng hěn shìhé nǐ.
examples.en: This outfit suits you well.

examples.pinyin: Fángjiān lǐ zhuāngle hěn duō dēng.
examples.en: They fitted the room with a lot of lights.

examples.pinyin: Tā míngnián yào qǔ qīzi.
examples.en: He is going to get married next year.

examples.pinyin: Tā qǔ le yí ge lǎoshī.
examples.en: He married a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ dǎsuàn shénme shíhou qǔ tā?
examples.en: When do you plan to marry her?

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng kǎchē néng zhuāng wǔ dūn.
examples.en: This truck can carry five tons.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dōngxi zhòng yì dūn.
examples.en: This thing weighs a ton.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dàmǐ yǒu liǎng dūn.
examples.en: There are two tons of rice here.

examples.zh: 这种行为会败坏公司的名声。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng xíngwéi huì bàihuài gōngsī de míngshēng.
examples.en: This kind of behavior damages the company's reputation.

examples.zh: 你为什么要败坏他的名誉？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme yào bàihuài tā de míngyù?
examples.en: Why would you want to ruin his reputation?

examples.pinyin: Áoyè huì bàihuài shēntǐ.
examples.en: Staying up late will ruin your health.

examples.pinyin: Tā shēngyù le liǎng ge háizi.
examples.en: She has had two children.

examples.zh: 很多动物在春天生育后代。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō dòngwù zài chūntiān shēngyù hòudài.
examples.en: Many animals give birth to their young in spring.

examples.zh: 这种鱼一次能生育很多后代。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yú yí cì néng shēngyù hěn duō hòudài.
examples.en: This kind of fish can produce a huge number of offspring at one time.

examples.zh: 下周我想去拜访一位老教授。
examples.pinyin: Xiàzhōu wǒ xiǎng qù bàifǎng yí wèi lǎo jiàoshòu.
examples.en: Next week I'd like to visit an old professor.

examples.zh: 他第一次拜访我们家时，带了很多水果。
examples.pinyin: Tā dì yī cì bàifǎng wǒmen jiā shí, dài le hěn duō shuǐguǒ.
examples.en: When he first visited our home, he brought a lot of fruit.

examples.zh: 去拜访朋友之前，最好先打个电话。
examples.pinyin: Qù bàifǎng péngyou zhīqián, zuìhǎo xiān dǎ ge diànhuà.
examples.en: Before visiting a friend, it's best to give them a call first.

examples.zh: 节日的时候，游客络绎不绝。
examples.pinyin: Jiérì de shíhou, yóukè luòyì bùjué.
examples.en: During the holiday, visitors kept coming in an endless stream.

examples.zh: 这家店的门口人来人往，络绎不绝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā diàn de ménkǒu rén lái rén wǎng, luòyì bùjué.
examples.en: People kept coming and going at the shop entrance in a steady stream.

examples.zh: 为了买票，人们络绎不绝地排着队。
examples.pinyin: Wèile mǎi piào, rénmen luòyì bùjué de páizhe duì.
examples.en: To buy tickets, people kept queuing in an endless line.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn ài wǒ de zǔguó.
examples.en: I love my homeland very much.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ líkāi zǔguó hěn jiǔ le.
examples.en: I've been away from my homeland for a long time.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎngniàn zǔguó ma?
examples.en: Do you miss your homeland?

examples.pinyin: Tā fēndeqīng shìfēi.
examples.en: He can tell right from wrong.

examples.pinyin: Bié zài bèihòu shuō biérén shìfēi.
examples.en: Don't gossip about other people behind their backs.

examples.zh: 我们不要卷入他们的是非。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen bú yào juǎnrù tāmen de shìfēi.
examples.en: Let's not get drawn into their quarrel.

examples.zh: 他很喜欢钻研数学问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuan zuānyán shùxué wèntí.
examples.en: He loves digging deep into math problems.

examples.zh: 这位工程师钻研新技术十多年了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi gōngchéngshī zuānyán xīn jìshù shí duō nián le.
examples.en: This engineer has studied new technology for over ten years.

examples.zh: 我们要钻研问题，而不是只看答案。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zuānyán wèntí, ér bú shì zhǐ kàn dá'àn.
examples.en: We should dig into problems instead of just looking at the answers.

examples.zh: 她眨了眨眼睛，好像在想什么。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎ le zhǎ yǎnjing, hǎoxiàng zài xiǎng shénme.
examples.en: She blinked, as if she were thinking about something.

examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎzha yǎn, zuò le ge guǐliǎn.
examples.en: He winked and made a funny face.

examples.zh: 这个小孩子眨着大眼睛看我。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiǎo háizi zhǎzhe dà yǎnjing kàn wǒ.
examples.en: The little child looked up at me with wide blinking eyes.

examples.zh: 大家热烈地欢迎新同学。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā rèliè de huānyíng xīn tóngxué.
examples.en: Everyone warmly welcomed the new classmates.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā de tǎolùn hěn rèliè.
examples.en: The discussion was very lively.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de wǎnhuì hěn rèliè.
examples.en: The party this time was very lively.

examples.zh: 我宁肯多花点时间，也要做好。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nìngkěn duō huā diǎn shíjiān, yě yào zuò hǎo.
examples.en: I'd rather spend more time and get it right.

examples.zh: 他宁肯饿着，也不吃这种东西。
examples.pinyin: Tā nìngkěn è zhe, yě bù chī zhè zhǒng dōngxi.
examples.en: He would go hungry rather than eat this sort of food.

examples.zh: 你宁肯相信他，也不相信我吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nìngkěn xiāngxìn tā, yě bù xiāngxìn wǒ ma?
examples.en: You'd rather believe him than me?

examples.zh: 这个花瓶是古董，很值钱。
examples.pinyin: Zhège huāpíng shì gǔdǒng, hěn zhíqián.
examples.en: This vase is an antique and very valuable.

examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan shōují gǔdǒng.
examples.en: He likes collecting antiques.

examples.zh: 博物馆里陈列着很多古董。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn lǐ chénliè zhe hěn duō gǔdǒng.
examples.en: The museum has many antiques on display.

examples.zh: 飞机的货舱里有很多行李。
examples.pinyin: Fēijī de huòcāng lǐ yǒu hěn duō xíngli.
examples.en: The plane's cargo hold is full of luggage.

examples.pinyin: Chuáncāng lǐ hěn mēnrè.
examples.en: The ship's cabin is stuffy and hot.

examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, zhè shì jǐ hào cāng?
examples.en: Excuse me, which cabin number is this?

examples.zh: 我在路上捡到一个钱包。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài lù shang jiǎndào yí ge qiánbāo.
examples.en: I found a wallet on the street.

examples.pinyin: Bié luàn jiǎn dìshang de dōngxi.
examples.en: Don't pick up things from the ground at random.

examples.pinyin: Tā jiǎnqǐ shū, fàng huí le shūjià.
examples.en: He picked up the book and put it back on the shelf.

examples.zh: 小狗叼着一根骨头跑了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo gǒu diāo zhe yì gēn gǔtou pǎo le.
examples.en: The puppy ran off with a bone in its mouth.

examples.zh: 他嘴里叼着一支笔，在想问题。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuǐ lǐ diāo zhe yì zhī bǐ, zài xiǎng wèntí.
examples.en: He had a pen between his teeth as he thought the problem over.

examples.zh: 猫叼来一条鱼，放在地上。
examples.pinyin: Māo diāo lái yì tiáo yú, fàng zài dì shàng.
examples.en: The cat carried over a fish and put it on the floor.

examples.zh: 老师给我们讲了一个寓言。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī gěi wǒmen jiǎng le yí ge yùyán.
examples.en: The teacher told us a fable.

examples.zh: 这个寓言告诉我们要踏实做事。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yùyán gàosu wǒmen yào tāshi zuò shì.
examples.en: This fable teaches us to work steadily.

examples.pinyin: Zhège gùshi shì yì zé yùyán.
examples.en: This story is a fable.

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā zài ménkǒu jíhé.
examples.en: Everyone, gather at the entrance.

examples.zh: 请大家八点在学校集合。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā bā diǎn zài xuéxiào jíhé.
examples.en: Please assemble at the school at eight.

examples.zh: 这些数字组成了一个集合。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shùzì zǔchéng le yí ge jíhé.
examples.en: These numbers form a set.

examples.pinyin: Xiǎoxīn, bié bèi zhēn zhā dào le.
examples.en: Careful, don't get pricked by the needle.

examples.pinyin: Méiguī huā de cì hěn zhā rén.
examples.en: Rose thorns really prick people.

examples.pinyin: Tā yòng zhēn zhā le yíxià shǒuzhǐ.
examples.en: He pricked his finger with a needle.

examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huódòng shì shéi zǔzhī de?
examples.en: Who organized this event?

examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào zǔzhī wǒmen qù gōngyuán.
examples.en: The school organized a trip for us to the park.

examples.zh: 这个组织帮助了很多人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zǔzhī bāngzhù le hěn duō rén.
examples.en: This organization has helped many people.

examples.zh: 这家公司研究尖端技术。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī yánjiū jiānduān jìshù.
examples.en: This company researches cutting-edge technology.

examples.zh: 这所大学的实验室很尖端。
examples.pinyin: Zhè suǒ dàxué de shíyànshì hěn jiānduān.
examples.en: This university's labs are very cutting-edge.

examples.zh: 他站在尖端，差点摔下来。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhàn zài jiānduān, chàdiǎn shuāi xiàlái.
examples.en: He stood on the very tip and nearly fell off.

examples.zh: 我的电脑装了一个新软件。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo zhuāngle yí ge xīn ruǎnjiàn.
examples.en: I installed a new piece of software on my computer.

examples.pinyin: Zhège ruǎnjiàn hěn hǎoyòng.
examples.en: This software is easy to use.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ huì yòng zhège ruǎnjiàn ma?
examples.en: Do you know how to use this software?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yào qù yóujú jì xìn.
examples.en: I'm going to the post office to mail a letter.

examples.pinyin: Yóujú jǐ diǎn guānmén?
examples.en: What time does the post office close?

examples.pinyin: Yóujú jiù zài yínháng pángbiān.
examples.en: The post office is right next to the bank.

examples.zh: 他致力于环境保护工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhìlìyú huánjìng bǎohù gōngzuò.
examples.en: He is dedicated to environmental protection work.

examples.zh: 这家公司致力于提供优质的服务。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngsī zhìlìyú tígōng yōuzhì de fúwù.
examples.en: This company is committed to providing high-quality service.

examples.zh: 她一生致力于儿童教育。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìshēng zhìlìyú értóng jiàoyù.
examples.en: She has devoted her whole life to children's education.

examples.pinyin: Míngtiān shuōbudìng huì xiàyǔ.
examples.en: It might rain tomorrow.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōbudìng yǐjīng dào jiā le.
examples.en: He may already be home.

examples.zh: 你去问问，说不定他知道。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù wènwen, shuōbudìng tā zhīdào.
examples.en: Go and ask, he might know.

examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén dōu yīnggāi yǒu zūnyán.
examples.en: Everyone deserves dignity.

examples.zh: 他不愿意为了钱失去尊严。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì wèile qián shīqù zūnyán.
examples.en: He refuses to lose his dignity for money.

examples.zh: 老师要尊重学生的尊严。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī yào zūnzhòng xuésheng de zūnyán.
examples.en: Teachers should respect students' dignity.

examples.zh: 现在不是说话的好时机。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài bú shì shuōhuà de hǎo shíjī.
examples.en: Now is not a good time to speak.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào zhuāzhù shíjī.
examples.en: We should seize the opportunity.

examples.zh: 他选择了最佳时机辞职。
examples.pinyin: Tā xuǎnzéle zuìjiā shíjī cízhí.
examples.en: He chose the best moment to resign.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng huí jiā.
examples.en: I want to go home.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng jiā le.
examples.en: I miss home.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ xiǎng xuéxí Hànyǔ ma?
examples.en: Do you want to study Chinese?

examples.zh: 这两个东西有什么差别？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge dōngxi yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.en: What's the difference between these two things?

examples.pinyin: Chéngshì hé nóngcūn chābié hěn dà.
examples.en: There is a big difference between cities and the countryside.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen de shuǐpíng méiyǒu chābié.
examples.en: Their level is no different.

examples.zh: 这个咖啡馆最近很热门。
examples.pinyin: Zhège kāfēiguǎn zuìjìn hěn rèmén.
examples.en: This café has become very popular lately.

examples.zh: 现在最热门的话题是什么？
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài zuì rèmén de huàtí shì shénme?
examples.en: What's the hottest topic right now?

examples.zh: 这个餐厅太热门了，我们得提前订位。
examples.pinyin: Zhège cāntīng tài rèmén le, wǒmen děi tíqián dìngwèi.
examples.en: This restaurant is so popular that we have to book ahead.

examples.zh: 我宁愿走路去，也不想坐车。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ nìngyuàn zǒulù qù, yě bù xiǎng zuò chē.
examples.en: I'd rather walk than take a bus.

examples.zh: 他宁愿自己吃亏，也不愿意麻烦别人。
examples.pinyin: Tā nìngyuàn zìjǐ chīkuī, yě bú yuànyì máfan biéren.
examples.en: He would rather lose out himself than trouble others.

examples.zh: 你宁愿在家休息，还是出去玩？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ nìngyuàn zài jiā xiūxi, háishi chūqù wán?
examples.en: Would you rather rest at home or go out and have fun?

examples.pinyin: Qǐng bǎ huā chā zài huāpíng lǐ.
examples.en: Please put the flowers in the vase.

examples.pinyin: Tā chā le yí jù huà.
examples.en: He chipped in with a remark.

examples.zh: 你的电脑插头插在哪里？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ de diànnǎo chātóu chā zài nǎlǐ?
examples.en: Where is your computer plug inserted?

examples.pinyin: Háizimen duì kǒnglóng hěn zháomí.
examples.en: The kids are fascinated by dinosaurs.

examples.zh: 你为什么对这本书这么着迷？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèishénme duì zhè běn shū zhème zháomí?
examples.en: Why are you so hooked on this book?

examples.zh: 她一看书就着迷，常常忘了吃饭。
examples.pinyin: Tā yí kàn shū jiù zháomí, chángcháng wàngle chī fàn.
examples.en: Once she starts reading she gets absorbed and often forgets to eat.

examples.pinyin: Yīnyuè shǐ rén kuàilè.
examples.en: Music makes people happy.

examples.pinyin: Tā de huà shǐ wǒ hěn shēngqì.
examples.en: His words made me angry.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de xiào shǐ wǒ hěn kāixīn.
examples.en: Your smile makes me so happy.

examples.zh: 他从口袋里掏出一把钥匙。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng kǒudài lǐ tāo chū yì bǎ yàoshi.
examples.en: He pulled a set of keys out of his pocket.

examples.zh: 她掏出手机，给朋友发了条消息。
examples.pinyin: Tā tāo chū shǒujī, gěi péngyou fā le tiáo xiāoxi.
examples.en: She took out her phone and sent a message to a friend.

examples.pinyin: Bié tāo ěrduo le, bú wèishēng.
examples.en: Stop poking in your ears; it's unhygienic.

examples.zh: 多吃蔬菜可以补充维生素。
examples.pinyin: Duō chī shūcài kěyǐ bǔchōng wéishēngsù.
examples.en: Eating more vegetables helps you get enough vitamins.

examples.zh: 橙子里含有很多维生素。
examples.pinyin: Chéngzi lǐ hányǒu hěn duō wéishēngsù.
examples.en: Oranges are full of vitamins.

examples.zh: 医生建议他每天吃一片维生素。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng jiànyì tā měitiān chī yí piàn wéishēngsù.
examples.en: The doctor advised him to take a vitamin tablet every day.

examples.pinyin: Tā qǔdé le hěn dà de chéngjiù.
examples.en: He has achieved a great deal.

examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ zuì dà de chéngjiù.
examples.en: This is my greatest achievement.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu shénme chéngjiù?
examples.en: What have you accomplished?

examples.pinyin: Tā de bùfá hěn wěn.
examples.en: His stride is steady.

examples.zh: 城市建设的步伐越来越快。
examples.pinyin: Chéngshì jiànshè de bùfá yuèláiyuè kuài.
examples.en: The pace of urban construction keeps getting faster.

examples.zh: 他迈着轻快的步伐走进教室。
examples.pinyin: Tā màizhe qīngkuài de bùfá zǒujìn jiàoshì.
examples.en: He walked into the classroom with a light step.

examples.zh: 他做事很务实，不喜欢空谈。
examples.pinyin: Tā zuò shì hěn wùshí, bù xǐhuan kōngtán.
examples.en: He is practical in his work and dislikes empty talk.

examples.zh: 我们要务实，不能只想着理想。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wùshí, bù néng zhǐ xiǎngzhe lǐxiǎng.
examples.en: We need to be practical and not just dream about ideals.

examples.pinyin: Zhège jìhuà hěn wùshí.
examples.en: This plan is very practical.

examples.zh: 两个朋友吵了一架，后来终于和解了。
examples.pinyin: Liǎng ge péngyou chǎo le yí jià, hòulái zhōngyú héjiě le.
examples.en: The two friends had a row, but in the end they made up.

examples.pinyin: Tāmen yuànyì zuò xiàlái héjiě.
examples.en: They are willing to sit down and make peace.

examples.zh: 你们俩和解吧，别再生气了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen liǎ héjiě ba, bié zài shēngqì le.
examples.en: The two of you should make up and stop being angry.

examples.pinyin: Lǎorén de dòngzuò yǒuxiē chíhuǎn.
examples.en: The old man's movements are a bit slow.

examples.zh: 他反应迟缓，需要多一点时间。
examples.pinyin: Tā fǎnyìng chíhuǎn, xūyào duō yìdiǎn shíjiān.
examples.en: He reacts slowly and needs a little more time.

examples.pinyin: Jīngjì zēngzhǎng biàn de chíhuǎn.
examples.en: Economic growth has become sluggish.

examples.zh: 老师的使命是教育学生。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de shǐmìng shì jiàoyù xuésheng.
examples.en: A teacher's mission is to educate students.

examples.zh: 他觉得自己有保护环境的使命。
examples.pinyin: Tā juéde zìjǐ yǒu bǎohù huánjìng de shǐmìng.
examples.en: He feels he has a mission to protect the environment.

examples.zh: 完成任务是我们的使命。
examples.pinyin: Wánchéng rènwu shì wǒmen de shǐmìng.
examples.en: Completing the task is our mission.

examples.zh: 他对音乐有着坚定的信仰。
examples.pinyin: Tā duì yīnyuè yǒuzhe jiāndìng de xìnyǎng.
examples.en: He has a firm belief in music.

examples.zh: 他坚信正义的力量，这是他的信仰。
examples.pinyin: Tā jiānxìn zhèngyì de lìliàng, zhè shì tā de xìnyǎng.
examples.en: He firmly believes in the power of justice, and that is his creed.

examples.zh: 我们要有自己的信仰和目标。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yǒu zìjǐ de xìnyǎng hé mùbiāo.
examples.en: We should have our own beliefs and goals.

examples.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ lái chéngdān zérèn.
examples.en: I'll take responsibility for this matter.

examples.zh: 公司承担了所有的费用。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī chéngdān le suǒyǒu de fèiyong.
examples.en: The company covered all the costs.

examples.zh: 他不愿意承担这个工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì chéngdān zhège gōngzuò.
examples.en: He doesn't want to take on this job.

examples.zh: 天空蒙蒙的，好像要下雨了。
examples.pinyin: Tiānkōng méngméng de, hǎoxiàng yào xià yǔ le.
examples.en: The sky is misty, as if it's about to rain.

examples.zh: 早上的细雨蒙蒙，你带伞了吗？
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang de xìyǔ méngméng, nǐ dài sǎn le ma?
examples.en: The morning drizzle is misty; did you bring an umbrella?

examples.pinyin: Chuāng wài bìng méiyǒu méngméng de yǔ.
examples.en: There's no misty drizzle outside the window.

examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zì shì shénme yìsi?
examples.en: What does this character mean?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de zì hěn piàoliang.
examples.en: My handwriting is very nice.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi zhè ge zì ma?
examples.en: Do you know this character?

examples.zh: 这位客户今天下午来公司。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi kèhù jīntiān xiàwǔ lái gōngsī.
examples.en: This client is coming to the office this afternoon.

examples.zh: 我们要为客户提供好服务。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào wèi kèhù tígōng hǎo fúwù.
examples.en: We have to give our customers good service.

examples.zh: 他是我们最重要的客户。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì wǒmen zuì zhòngyào de kèhù.
examples.en: He is our most important client.

examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū de shùliàng hěn duō.
examples.en: There are a lot of these books.

examples.pinyin: Mǎi de shùliàng bù duō.
examples.en: We didn't buy many.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yào suàn yíxià shùliàng.
examples.en: Let's count how many there are.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen fǎngwèn le yí wèi lǎoshī.
examples.en: We visited a teacher.

examples.pinyin: Tā lái Zhōngguó fǎngwèn.
examples.en: He came to China for a visit.

examples.zh: 这个网站每天都有很多访问。
examples.pinyin: Zhège wǎngzhàn měitiān dōu yǒu hěn duō fǎngwèn.
examples.en: This website gets many visits every day.

examples.zh: 他总是被手机控制，成了手机的奴隶。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì bèi shǒujī kòngzhì, chéng le shǒujī de núlì.
examples.en: He is always controlled by his phone and has become its slave.

examples.zh: 别做时间的奴隶，要学会休息。
examples.pinyin: Bié zuò shíjiān de núlì, yào xuéhuì xiūxi.
examples.en: Don't be a slave to time; learn to rest.

examples.zh: 他不愿意做工作的奴隶。
examples.pinyin: Tā bú yuànyì zuò gōngzuò de núlì.
examples.en: He doesn't want to be a slave to his job.

examples.pinyin: Tā xiào de hěn hǎokàn.
examples.en: She has a lovely smile.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ wèi shénme xiào?
examples.en: Why are you laughing?

examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu xiào le.
examples.en: Everyone laughed.

examples.pinyin: Zhège dàolǐ bù yán ér yù.
examples.en: This principle is self-evident.

examples.zh: 他努力学习，成绩提高是不言而喻的。
examples.pinyin: Tā nǔlì xuéxí, chéngjì tígāo shì bù yán ér yù de.
examples.en: He studies hard, so it goes without saying that his grades went up.

examples.zh: 健康比什么都重要，这一点不言而喻。
examples.pinyin: Jiànkāng bǐ shénme dōu zhòngyào, zhè yì diǎn bù yán ér yù.
examples.en: Health matters more than anything, and that goes without saying.

examples.zh: 这里的交通每天都很糟糕，我真的不堪忍受。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ de jiāotōng měitiān dōu hěn zāogāo, wǒ zhēn de bù kān rěnshòu.
examples.en: The traffic here is awful every day, and I really can't stand it any more.

examples.zh: 她的衣服破得不堪，只能扔掉。
examples.pinyin: Tā de yīfu pò de bù kān, zhǐ néng rēngdiào.
examples.en: Her clothes were so worn out that they had to be thrown away.

examples.zh: 这间房子很久没人住，破旧不堪。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiān fángzi hěn jiǔ méi rén zhù, pòjiù bùkān.
examples.en: This house has been empty for ages and is falling apart.

examples.pinyin: Bié dānwu shíjiān.
examples.en: Don't waste time.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ de gōngzuò bèi dānwu le.
examples.en: My work was delayed.

examples.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, dānwu nǐ yíxià.
examples.en: Sorry to take up a moment of your time.

examples.zh: 电视声音太大，干扰我学习。
examples.pinyin: Diànshì shēngyīn tài dà, gānrǎo wǒ xuéxí.
examples.en: The TV is too loud and disturbs my studying.

examples.pinyin: Shǒujī xìnhào shòudào gānrǎo.
examples.en: The phone signal is being interfered with.

examples.zh: 请不要在考试时干扰别人。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng bú yào zài kǎoshì shí gānrǎo biérén.
examples.en: Please don't disturb others during the exam.

examples.zh: 大家都拥护这个好主意。
examples.pinyin: Dàjiā dōu yōnghù zhège hǎo zhǔyì.
examples.en: Everyone supports this good idea.

examples.zh: 我们拥护公司的新规定。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yōnghù gōngsī de xīn guīdìng.
examples.en: We support the company's new rules.

examples.zh: 他的建议得到了很多人的拥护。
examples.pinyin: Tā de jiànyì dédào le hěn duō rén de yōnghù.
examples.en: His suggestion won the backing of many people.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de tǐhuì shì shénme?
examples.en: What did you take away from it?

examples.zh: 在国外生活，我有很多体会。
examples.pinyin: Zài guówài shēnghuó, wǒ yǒu hěn duō tǐhuì.
examples.en: Living abroad, I have gained a lot of insight.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn tǐhuì māma de xīnkǔ.
examples.en: I really understand how hard Mom's work is.

examples.pinyin: Mèngxiǎng shì tā qiánjìn de dònglì.
examples.en: His dream is what drives him forward.

examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē de dònglì hěn qiáng.
examples.en: This car has a powerful engine.

examples.zh: 有了奖励，大家都有了工作的动力。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le jiǎnglì, dàjiā dōu yǒu le gōngzuò de dònglì.
examples.en: With the rewards, everyone felt motivated to work.

examples.zh: 他住在郊外的一幢别墅里。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhù zài jiāowài de yí zhuàng biéshù lǐ.
examples.en: He lives in a villa on the outskirts of town.

examples.zh: 这座别墅有一个很大的花园。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò biéshù yǒu yí ge hěn dà de huāyuán.
examples.en: This villa has a very large garden.

examples.zh: 周末我们去海边的别墅度假。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen qù hǎibiān de biéshù dùjià.
examples.en: At weekends we go on holiday to a seaside villa.

examples.zh: 帮助别人是一种崇高的品质。
examples.pinyin: Bāngzhù biérén shì yì zhǒng chónggāo de pǐnzhì.
examples.en: Helping others is a noble quality.

examples.pinyin: Tā de lǐxiǎng fēicháng chónggāo.
examples.en: His ideals are very lofty.

examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò hěn chónggāo.
examples.en: A doctor's work is very noble.

examples.pinyin: Zuò xuéwèn bù néng jí gōng jìn lì.
examples.en: Scholarship can't be pursued for quick gains.

examples.zh: 他总是急功近利，不肯慢慢积累。
examples.pinyin: Tā zǒngshì jí gōng jìn lì, bù kěn mànmàn jīlěi.
examples.en: He always chases quick results and won't build things up slowly.

examples.zh: 这种急功近利的想法不好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng jí gōng jìn lì de xiǎngfǎ bù hǎo.
examples.en: This shortsighted way of thinking is not good.

examples.zh: 新的图书馆下个月落成。
examples.pinyin: Xīn de túshūguǎn xià ge yuè luòchéng.
examples.en: The new library will be completed next month.

examples.zh: 这座大楼什么时候落成？
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàlóu shénme shíhou luòchéng?
examples.en: When will this building be finished?

examples.pinyin: Tǐyùguǎn hái méiyǒu luòchéng.
examples.en: The gymnasium is not finished yet.

examples.pinyin: Tā shuōhuà hěn yǒu qìshì.
examples.en: He speaks with real force.

examples.zh: 这座大楼看起来很有气势。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò dàlóu kàn qǐlái hěn yǒu qìshì.
examples.en: This building looks very impressive.

examples.zh: 比赛刚开始，两队的气势都很强。
examples.pinyin: Bǐsài gāng kāishǐ, liǎng duì de qìshì dōu hěn qiáng.
examples.en: The match had just begun, and both teams were full of momentum.

examples.pinyin: Zhè kuǎn shǒujī xiāoshòu de hěn hǎo.
examples.en: This phone is selling very well.

examples.pinyin: Tā zài gōngsī fùzé xiāoshòu.
examples.en: He is in charge of sales at the company.

examples.zh: 你们的销售情况怎么样？
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen de xiāoshòu qíngkuàng zěnmeyàng?
examples.en: How are your sales doing?

examples.pinyin: Tā zài yì jiā dà qǐyè gōngzuò.
examples.en: He works at a large company.

examples.zh: 这家企业有一千名员工。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā qǐyè yǒu yìqiān míng yuángōng.
examples.en: This company has a thousand employees.

examples.zh: 很多企业都开始用电脑管理。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō qǐyè dōu kāishǐ yòng diànnǎo guǎnlǐ.
examples.en: Many companies have started managing things with computers.
